description: Delegate a codebase investigation to the code-reviewer subagent, then fix ONLY the file it flags, leaving the distractor files untouched. Checks the parent stays on-task after a read-heavy delegation instead of being derailed by the subagent's exploration.
judge_criteria: The code-reviewer subagent was invoked to investigate the code, compute_total now sums every element, and the unrelated files (tax.py, format.py, main.py) were left untouched.
